name: processamento-em-lote-monorepo
description: Sistema de processamento em lote com monitoramento Backstage
author: nayanbecker

scripts.backstage:install: npm install && cd backstage && npm install && cd packages/plugin-batch-monitor && npm install && cd ../app && npm install
scripts.backstage:build: cd backstage/packages/plugin-batch-monitor && npm run build && cd ../..
scripts.backstage:start: npm run backstage:build && cd backstage/app && npm start
scripts.backstage:dev: npm run backstage:build && cd backstage/app && npm start
scripts.backstage:clean: cd backstage/packages/plugin-batch-monitor && npm run clean && cd ../app && npm run clean
